candidate.name: Cold-chain quarantine directive API
candidate.ordinaryOutcome: For each confirmed contaminated lot, create exactly one quarantine directive with the approved quantity and reason confirmation, while leaving unrelated lots and directives unchanged.

inputs.directive_ref: string; stable identity and idempotency key

candidate.authority: preauthorized bounded quarantine directive; hold_quantity <= 500; reason_confirmed=true; no release, delete or unrelated-lot action; one exact execution attempt unless signed independent not-started evidence permits one replacement attempt
candidate.independentOutcome: a separately authenticated read-only audit process returns exactly one matching directive, exact input-bound fields, a trusted timestamp/version, duplicate count and collateral-state result; the action response is never accepted as proof

causalJoin.rule: The capability acquired by the real CF-053 production-derived content-addressed registry must be the exact reviewed capability compiled into the CF-054 through CF-060 signed-authority provider execution path.

CF-036 workPack.factoryResultDigest equals the reviewed HTTP binding-factory result digest

causalJoin.forbiddenShortcut: Do not execute the CF-053 author-known provider bytes beside an unrelated signed-HTTPS provider and call that joined evidence.

processBoundary.actionProvider: separate localhost TLS 1.3 Node child process with an action-only route, distinct leaf certificate and action credential
processBoundary.observerProvider: separate localhost TLS 1.3 Node child process with read-only audit routes, distinct trust root/leaf certificate and observer credential, and no action route
processBoundary.customerRunner: separate customer-local Node child process that owns compiled bindings, registry, trust, authority and scenario state
processBoundary.sharedTruth: the action and observer processes may share one durable fictional truth store, but their code, network endpoints, credentials, certificate pins and permitted routes remain distinct

cases.expected: A pre-existing exact directive is independently observed as complete with zero action requests, reservations, authority leases and business writes.
One exact reviewed PUT receives current authority, writes once, is independently observed as complete, and leaves zero collateral effects.
A genuinely fresh customer-runner child reopens the same registry, acquires the exact candidate as retained, completes one new directive, and preserves build ordinal one.
An unavailable action credential alias stops before transport preparation, authority reservation, lease issuance, network activity and business write.
The credential exists but exact signed activation is absent or revoked; any pre-authority transport reservation is cancelled and no lease is consumed, network request sent or business write made.

subcases.expected: A generation-one lease is prepared but its process dies before consumption; after expiry the durable authority store retires it and issues generation two; the provider drops before commit; the independent observer signs not-started; exactly one attempt-two reissue writes once.
The provider commits once and loses the response; independent observation classifies the outcome completed and no retry or duplicate write occurs.

cases.expected: The disposable fixture pre-seeds a partial state that Capability Factory did not create; the independent observer classifies it partial, quarantines and refuses resumption with zero action requests, authority leases, CF-caused writes or automatic retries.

A write commits and the customer runner exits before the parent completion receipt; JsonFileGenericAcceptanceCampaignStore marks the case reconciliation-required; a fresh child reopens durable trust, authority and campaign state, independently observes completion, records the reconciliation receipt and resumes without a second write.

The exact same parent, work item, stable identity and input are submitted twice; the duplicate returns the prior verified outcome before a new lease whenever possible and exactly one business write exists.
The same directive_ref is resubmitted with changed lot_code or hold_quantity; it is rejected before authority or network activity and the original one-write outcome remains unchanged.
